[package]
name = "codegraph_engine"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["ProCoder System"]
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "codegraph_engine"
path = "src/lib.rs"
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[dependencies]
# Rustler for NIF bridge
rustler = "0.31.0"

# Tree-sitter for AST parsing
tree-sitter = "0.20.10"
tree-sitter-elixir = "0.20.0"

[profile.release]
# Optimize for speed to ensure low-latency AST parsing
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = true
